query: What customer issues create the most support burden?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: The category/type of issue is a driver or classifier of what generates burden, not an aspect OF the burden itself. Operational burden is constituted by facets like handling time, effort, volume, escalation, and reopen rate -- not by the taxonomy of the issue that causes it. It is a predictor of burden, failing the meronymy test.

per_column.name: burden_score
per_column.rationale: A single aggregate burden score is a restatement of the whole focus concept, not a decomposition into constitutive parts. A faceted decomposition requires breaking burden into non-overlapping component aspects; a composite score collapses the concept back into one number rather than carving it up.

judge.rationale: Neither added column is a constitutive facet (part-of) of operational_burden. 'issue_category' is an external predictor/classifier of what causes burden, and 'burden_score' is a restatement of the whole concept rather than one of its parts. With no genuine facets present, the set does not carve the concept into non-overlapping aspects (mutual exclusivity trivially 0) and covers none of its constitutive dimensions such as time-on-task, escalation, reopens, or agent effort (exhaustiveness 0). The faceted decomposition claim is not realised.
